ops.text: Notwithstanding Section 2.1, Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us no way out of a three-year term without cause, so we have inserted Section 9.4 with a Customer termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice, a refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term, expressed to prevail over Section 2.1. This is our preferred position; if helpful we can discuss 60 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9.4: Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid Fees and no Vendor convenience right

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
